# AGENTS.md — Build, Test, and Validation Commands
# Auto-generated by spec-to-ralphprep
# Project: ap-hub (AI Accountant Hub)
# Stack: Node 20 + TypeScript + Postgres + pg-boss + Anthropic Claude vision

## Environment

```bash
cp .env.example .env   # then fill in values before first run
```

Required environment variables (see .env.example for full list):
# DATABASE_URL, ENCRYPTION_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
# GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, WATCHED_LABEL
# QBO_ENV (sandbox), QBO_SANDBOX_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REALM_ID/COMPANY_NAME, QBO_MINOR_VERSION
# AUTO_THRESHOLD, REVIEW_THRESHOLD, AMOUNT_CEILING
# SWARMSYNC_API_BASE, SWARMSYNC_WEB_BASE, SWARMSYNC_API_KEY (proof suite — Amendment A1)
# GATEKEEPER_ENABLED, QBO_FORWARDING_ADDRESS, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (Phase 0.5)

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Database

```bash
docker compose up -d db     # local Postgres
npm run migrate:up          # run migrations (node-pg-migrate)
npm run seed                # dev seed data
npm run db:reset            # drop + recreate (dev only)
```

## Development / Test / Build

```bash
npm run dev                 # start service (poller + pg-boss workers)
npm run cli -- <command>    # ap-hub CLI (poll, proposals, post, void, env, ...)
npm test                    # unit tests (vitest run)
npm run test:int            # integration (Gmail read / QBO sandbox / LLM) — chunk boundaries only
npm run lint                # eslint
npm run typecheck           # tsc --noEmit
npm run build               # tsc -> dist/
```

## Validation Gate (ralph runs after every task — must exit 0)

```bash
npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
```

Gate = lint + type check + unit tests. test:int needs live sandbox creds; run it at chunk boundaries, not every task.
